### God and King
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-and-king
Passage: Psalm 21:1-13
Points:
- An authentic ruler for God's people rejoices in divine strength rather than self-glory.
- David acknowledged that his military victories and royal blessings came directly from the Lord.
- The psalm's celebration of everlasting life and glory finds ultimate fulfillment in Jesus Christ.
- God exalted Jesus at His resurrection and ascension, crowning Him with heavenly majesty.
- Believers can remain confident that Christ will finally overcome every opposing enemy.
